description: Read a draft or submitted eval record by id. The id is stable across submit, so it resolves a record whether it is still a draft or already submitted.

id.description: The record id to read, e.g. "ev_7Qk2mNpXa".

name: evals_get_record

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: No record exists with the given id. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

record.description: The full eval record, including its grader, discrimination cases, and verification evidence.

title: evals-mcp-server: get record
